meta.description: Albums not yet matched to a release on MusicBrainz, or whose tracks have no audio fingerprints yet. Most other fixes need both: fingerprints find duplicate and misnumbered tracks, and the MusicBrainz match is where covers, tags and track lists are looked up. "Identify all" fingerprints and matches the whole library in one go.
meta.label: Album not yet identified

meta.description: Albums whose tags differ from what MusicBrainz has for the release, lack a title, artist, year or genre, or lack the sort names players such as Plex and Roon use to alphabetise. Fix applies everything MusicBrainz can supply in one step and asks AI only for what it cannot: genre, or any field on an album not yet matched to MusicBrainz.
meta.label: Tags don't match canonical

meta.description: Albums whose track numbers skip (1, 2, 4) or repeat (1, 2, 2). This looks only at the track number tags; the same audio stored twice is found by "Duplicate audio files". Fix works out the right numbers by matching titles against MusicBrainz, then by looking up each track's audio fingerprint on AcoustID, and asks AI last.
meta.label: Track-number gaps & duplicates

meta.description: Albums by the same artist credited in different ways ("Ray Conniff", "Ray Conniff & His Orchestra", "Ray Conniff, his Orchestra and Chorus") whose sort names disagree. Giving them all the same album artist sort name lists them together in players such as Plex and Roon.
meta.label: Inconsistent artist sort

meta.description: Albums with no cover: none embedded in the files and no cover.jpg, folder.jpg or front.jpg in the folder. Fix looks for one on MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive first, and asks AI only when they have none. An album whose lookup failed recently is skipped for a while, so a bulk run does not keep retrying it.
meta.label: No cover art

meta.description: Albums that hold the same recording more than once: files whose audio fingerprints match, whatever their names or tags say. This needs fingerprints, which Musaic computes in the background after a scan. Resolve lets you choose which copy to keep.
meta.label: Duplicate audio files

meta.description: Albums with files not named the way your file name pattern says (Settings, Filename templates). Names drift: rippers use different conventions, tags get edited after the rip, or you change the pattern. Resolve shows the current and the new name of every track, then renames them together.
meta.label: Filename doesn't match template
